mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper establishes brevibacillin 2V as a non-ribosomally produced modified lipo-tridecapeptide; this is identity/structure evidence, not a direct antimicrobial target claim.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural identity evidence is retained only as context; no antimicrobial target or mode-of-action mechanism was tested in this claim.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The source supports antibacterial phenotype and checkerboard synergy with marketed antibiotics; this is phenotypic/adjuvant evidence, not direct mode-of-action proof.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Brevibacillins in Table 1/Table 2/supplementary DOC synergy assays
mechanism_claims.limitations: FICI rows are synergy phenotypes; they do not identify a molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Low hemolysis/cytotoxicity and plasma-stability observations support developability context for brevibacillin 2V, with non-2V exact CC50 conflicts retained in the database layer.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Host-toxicity and plasma-stability evidence is retained as safety/developability context, not antimicrobial mode-of-action evidence.

ontology_normalization.rationale: Two local context labels were normalized because the claim text and source locators explicitly avoid direct mechanism closure; no direct mechanism claim was promoted.
